about: The playthrough's Azalea Gym, its first two trainers, from Azalea's Pokemon Center: the gym is crossed on Spinarak carts, which ride when the player steps onto a station (a coord event, AzaleaGymSpinarak), along the routes src/field/gymmick/azalea.c gives for the station and the two switches; the navigator walks each room and the leg names the rides, each followed by the tile it lands on. Bottom room: station 1 to the middle right, Bug Catcher Al; back; station 0 to the middle, Bug Catcher Benny; down by station 4 and out to the nurse, and the game's save. A loss sends the player to the nurse, and again: rides back and fights that trainer again until trainer: reads him beaten, each attempt a new battle (the battle seed one higher), four times more at most. The party is the bot's own as leg 07b left it, no edit: swap: puts the Hoothoot first, at 10 the team's weakest, so that the bugs, weak to its Peck, pay it what it beats, then the Quilava -- or the Cyndaquil, which becomes one at 16 -- whose Fire they fear, the Misdreavus, the Geodude at 19, whose Rock moves they fear too, the Mareep and the egg. Where the leg was written both were won the first time, the Quilava doing most of it (40,113 frames). On the merged tree of round 14 Falkner falls at the first attempt, not the fifth, the Cyndaquil comes at 15, not yet a Quilava, and evolves here; both are won the first time, 41,111 frames as the joined chain plays it. The field's RNG is pinned and the battle's seed fixed.
